name: Get brand assets
description: Call this when you need the account's stored brand identity — the brand website, name, logo, colour palette and fonts — before generating or styling content such as a campaign or template so it matches the account's branding. The response includes a flag indicating whether the brand has already been scraped; when the flag is false the brand fields are empty, so treat the palette and fonts as unavailable rather than as deliberately empty values. This operation is read‑only: use the account‑settings capability to read general account details, and the editor capabilities to apply styling to a specific design.
preconditions: An authenticated web-app session for the Brevo account whose brand is being read.

website.description: The website URL the brand was derived from. Empty string when no brand website has been set.

branding.description: The stored brand identity. Fields are empty or null placeholders until the brand has been fetched.

fetched.description: True once brand details have been successfully retrieved from the website; false means the remaining fields are unpopulated placeholders.

logo.description: Brand logo reference, empty when not fetched.

colors.description: Brand colour palette, null when not fetched.

fonts.description: Brand fonts, null when not fetched.

fetchRetryCount.description: Number of attempts made to fetch the brand from the website.

fetchedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful fetch; the zero value "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z" means never fetched.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the stored brand; the zero value "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z" means never updated.
